changeSet.author: MANFOUO Braun
changeSet.comment: tnt_incidents.agency_id was NOT NULL, but GO/FREELANCER-platform deliveries have no agency (Delivery.agencyId is null for these platforms — responsibility is tracked via responsible_org_id/responsible_org_type instead, added in 003). As written, the schema made it structurally impossible for a freelancer to ever report an incident. The domain aggregate (Incident.createWithFreelancerOrg) already accepted a null agencyId; only the column constraint and the REST/command-layer @NotNull annotations disagreed.
